description: The atom \(q\) lies between \(p\land q\) and \(q\lor r\) in semantic consequence and uses only atoms occurring in both.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.CraigInterpolation.propositional_example.{w} {α : Type w} (p q r : α) :
  (∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v
            ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom p).conj
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q)) =
          true →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q) =
          true) ∧
    (∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q) =
            true →
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v
              ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q).disj
                (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom r)) =
            true) ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q) ⊆
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
            ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom p).conj
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q)) ∩
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
            ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom q).disj
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom r))
